svg.title: Cloud Threat Investigation architecture
svg.desc: Provider logs and normalized records flow through adapters and import validation into the evidence engine (scoring, provenance graph, response analysis, ATT&CK context, signing), then into the signed case workflow and SQLite workspace, and out to the analyst UI, signed archives, SIEM summary and an offline verifier.
